calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(net_amount) AS net, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
WITH a AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS d, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.business_date, r.receipts, a.rc, r.units_sold, a.units, r.net_sales_before_returns, a.net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r LEFT JOIN a ON a.d=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=102 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
 SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
 GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
 SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT so.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand, so.units_sold, so.versions, COALESCE(rt.units_returned,0) AS ret
FROM sold so JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=so.sku AND cp.is_current LEFT JOIN ret rt ON rt.sku=so.sku
ORDER BY so.units_sold DESC LIMIT 8
